title: Describble dictionary language file
description: The words of one language for the concepts in concepts.json. All words are lowercase; multi-word phrases are fine and take precedence over single words.

language.description: Two-letter code, same as the file name (it.json → it).

name.description: The language's own name, e.g. Italiano.

concepts.description: Concept id (from concepts.json) → words that mean it.

colors.description: Colour → words for it; they colour the nearest noun.

hairOnlyColors.description: Words that already are a hair colour (blond, redhead).

colorNouns.description: Nouns a colour can attach to (hair, eyes, clothes, background).

contextual.description: Concept → adjectives that count only next to the right noun (long hair, not a long coat).

ignored.description: Words that are understood but change nothing (man, person).

negations.description: Words that remove what follows (without, senza).

scopeBreakers.description: Words that end a negation (but, ma).
